label: PF Backlog 614
title: BI-PF-1336 refinement: keep correctness gates (merge-gate, feature-pr, validation-engine, backlog-e2e) on the PR path
body: BI-PF-1336 moved ALL deep gates off the PR path. But merge-gate, feature-pr, validation-engine and backlog-e2e are the genuine "safe to merge" checks (relatively quick, e.g. merge-gate ~26s). Keep the CORRECTNESS gates on every PR; move only the heavy/expensive work (full test suite, dogfood*, release, final-audit, secret-scan-all) to the scheduled full-sweep. Split by COST, not by fast/deep.

Measured PR gate time stays bounded (target: a few minutes, not 8-20).
